description: Curated schema for beauty products sales data with data quality metadata

fields.name: month
fields.description: Transaction month in ISO date format (YYYY-MM-DD)
fields.transformation: Parse from M/DD/YYYY format to DATE
fields.business_definition: The month in which the sales transactions occurred

fields.name: product_id
fields.transformation: Parse from scientific notation (e.g., 1.72938E+18) to BIGINT
validation_rules: Generate synthetic ID if original is invalid
fields.business_definition: Unique identifier for each product in the catalog

fields.name: product_name
fields.transformation: Trim whitespace, normalize encoding, limit to 500 characters
fields.business_definition: Human-readable name of the product

fields.name: shop_name
fields.transformation: Trim whitespace, normalize encoding, limit to 200 characters
fields.business_definition: Name of the shop or seller offering the product

fields.name: l1_category
fields.transformation: Trim whitespace, default to 'Uncategorized' if null
fields.business_definition: Top-level category in the product taxonomy

fields.name: l2_category
fields.transformation: Trim whitespace, default to 'Uncategorized' if null
fields.business_definition: Second-level category in the product taxonomy

fields.name: l3_category
fields.transformation: Trim whitespace, default to 'Uncategorized' if null
fields.business_definition: Most detailed category in the product taxonomy

fields.name: item_sold
fields.transformation: Remove commas, parse as integer, default to 0 if invalid
fields.business_definition: Number of units sold in the given month

fields.name: revenue_usd
fields.transformation: Remove currency symbols and commas, parse as decimal, default to 0.00 if invalid
fields.business_definition: Total revenue generated from product sales in US dollars

fields.name: avg_unit_price_usd
fields.transformation: Remove currency symbols and commas, parse as decimal, default to 0.00 if invalid
fields.business_definition: Average price per unit sold in US dollars

fields.name: mom_growth_pct
fields.description: Month-over-month growth rate as decimal ratio
fields.transformation: Remove % symbol, divide by 100 to get decimal ratio
validation_rules: Null allowed for first month data
fields.business_definition: Month-over-month revenue growth rate expressed as decimal (-0.42 = -42% decline)

fields.name: source_file
fields.transformation: Captured during ETL processing
fields.business_definition: S3 path of the source CSV file for data lineage

fields.name: source_record_number
fields.description: Line number in source CSV file
fields.transformation: Generated during ETL processing
fields.business_definition: Record number in source file for traceability

fields.name: processed_timestamp
fields.transformation: Current timestamp during ETL execution
fields.business_definition: When the record was processed and written to curated zone

fields.name: transformation_version
fields.description: Version of ETL transformation logic applied
fields.transformation: Job parameter passed to ETL
fields.business_definition: Version of transformation rules for change tracking

fields.name: data_quality_score
fields.transformation: Calculated based on validation rule violations
fields.business_definition: Composite score indicating data quality (1.0 = perfect, 0.0 = poor)

fields.name: quality_flags
fields.description: Comma-separated list of quality issues detected
fields.transformation: Concatenated from quality checks
fields.business_definition: Flags indicating specific data quality issues for remediation

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Job or user that created the record
fields.transformation: Set to job name during ETL
fields.business_definition: Source of the curated record for governance

fields.name: record_hash
fields.description: MD5 hash of key fields for deduplication
fields.transformation: MD5(product_id||month||shop_name||product_name||revenue)
fields.business_definition: Hash for detecting duplicate records

fields.name: year
fields.transformation: YEAR(month)
fields.business_definition: Partition key for query optimization

fields.name: month_num
fields.transformation: MONTH(month)
fields.business_definition: Partition key for query optimization

data_quality_rules.scoring_formula: Start at 1.0000, subtract penalties for each violation
data_quality_rules.note: DUPLICATE_RECORD is handled separately in Step 4 (deduplication) and does not affect quality score. Duplicates are routed to error bucket.

partitioning.strategy: Range partitioning by time for query optimization

storage.note: Replace {environment} with dev, staging, prod, or poc based on deployment
